main.description: Answers where the caller stood before.

description: Takes the caller out of an organization they left by deleting their dev.knotless.orgAcceptance record, through the gateway the organization delegated writes to: out of its records, its space and its private repositories' spaces, but for repositories shared with them on their own. The membership ended with the record; this takes back what the organization had let them read. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method.
